status: assumed (OQ-029 default A): not canon until the owner decides; re-measure at the alpha live check (tech.streaming.live_check)
about: live = rate x max lifetime for loops at full intensity (after the tier's rate scale) plus every burst's emit count; fill = live x mean size squared (stud^2), an overdraw proxy; lights include the baseline cab lights.

baseline.note: cab lamp (shadows on) and desk SurfaceLight from style.light.*; the firebox light is counted in firebox_glow

priorities.1: crisis signal (must read on every device)

cruise.use: normal running at the fast notch

crisis_stack.use: worst realistic stack: valve open, electrics down, axle sparks, someone shovelling, brakes on

night_tunnel.use: Night Running or a tunnel with the headlamp on while braking

storm_crisis.use: rain plus a pressure crisis and axle sparks (OQ-027 option B or C only)

derail.use: derail burst over cruise (OQ-028 option B only)

windows.use: windows crisis over cruise with the valve open

arrival_brake.use: braking into a station at speed (gameplay.run.brake_formula)

pressure_brake.use: pressure redline answered with the brake and the valve while someone shovels (gameplay.crisis.pressure)

carriage_split.use: carriage split (mission 260929-train-splits): split burst, torn-edge smoke, one wreck landing, the two nearest panes, over cruise (the real peak is t 1.5-1.6 s)

carriage_split_inside.use: the same split with the preview twin used for the interior tile (identical cost)
